p_ch1: Built an XGBoost churn classifier in R using tidymodels, performing two-stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE within the recipe, and evaluating with MCC for classification.
p_gg2: Designed per-gene protein-prediction models for 11,459 genes using OLS and a GPU Random Forest ensemble, training resumable chunked GPU models on a free T4 regression.
